title: Reel manifest
description: Declarative description of one short-form talking reel. The orchestrating model fills this from the editor brief; render-reel.py executes it; qa-reel.py checks the output against it. Times are seconds as numbers. Paths are absolute or relative to the manifest's directory. Never put a client surname or address in any text field that is rendered on screen (cover.text, broll[].super.text, supers).

id.description: Content id, e.g. AB-20260917-05. Used as the filename prefix.

version.description: Output version. 'auto' picks the next free _vN in output_dir. The renderer never overwrites an existing version.

output_dir.description: Where the finished mp4, its RUNNOTES, captions .ass, qa report and frames land.

copy_to.description: Extra directories that receive a copy of the mp4 and RUNNOTES (a review folder, a cloud drive).

platforms.description: Targets. The strictest safe zone and loudness target among them wins.

duration_window.description: [min_s, max_s] for the finished file including the hook.

video.description: Camera file for the talking spine.

color.description: auto = measure with signalstats YMIN on sampled frames; log = apply lut; rec709 = skip lut.

lut.description: 3D .cube applied to log sources before eq and text. Comes from the client's video pipeline README.

eq.description: ffmpeg eq= params after the LUT for A-roll match. null = engine default. The literal string "none" disables the eq (grainy or already-matched footage).

rotate.description: Only when the brief says a sideways clip must be rotated.

quote.description: First and last words of the range, for a human reader and for the hook-once lint.

hard_out.description: End time of the last kept WORD (from the word JSON). Never an SRT cue end. The last range's end is clamped to this.

mode.description: none = the take opens on its own hook (play once). prepend = a later grab plays first as its own clip.

source.description: Camera file for the hook. null = source.video.

transcript_json.description: Word JSON for the hook source when it is a different file (captions).

lift_from_spine.description: false (default): the hook opens the cut and the full edit then plays through, so the line repeats once in context. true: remove its range from the spine so the line plays once.

text.description: Public-safe line, 7 words or fewer. Rendered in the brand display face.

font.description: Absolute font file path. From the client's design pack.

darken.description: Dim one frame under the title when the still is too bright.

font.description: Absolute font file path for the body/sans face.

style.description: phrase = 1-2 line cues; word = one highlighted word at a time (karaoke).

placement.description: safe-lower = just above the strictest platform bottom safe zone; safe-center = vertical center.

margin_v.description: Override in px from the bottom when placement = custom.

kind.description: auto = decide by file type. still = run stills-to-broll first.

path.description: Clip or still to punch in. An empty string means 'not sourced yet': broll-search.py --lines-from-manifest proposes candidates for it, and render-reel.py refuses to render (exit 2) until it is filled.

at.description: Time on the CUT SPINE (before hook prepend) where the punch starts.

dur.description: Seconds on screen. Clips stay under 3.0; stills read at 3.5; a punch carrying a super holds 3.5 to 4.0.

src.description: In-point inside a clip. null = mid-clip.

line.description: The spoken words this punch illustrates. Required for the relevance review; the renderer copies it into RUNNOTES.

shows.description: What the picture literally shows, written after looking at it (object, setting, material). Required whenever path is non-empty; render-reel preflight warns when it is missing.

focus.description: Stills only: crop centre as fractions of width/height.

zoom.description: Stills only: end zoom of the slow push.

eq.description: null = same eq as the A-roll (or the stills default). 'none' = no eq.

text.description: Short public-safe annotation (a date, a place). Upper third.

verified.description: Kept for compatibility; shows plus the verifier grade are the evidence.

grade.description: Filled by the verifier stage, never by the author.

graded_by.description: Who filled grade (verifier or owner). Optional.

joins.description: auto = every concat boundary between spine ranges, computed from the cut timeline. The engine covers each join with the nearest punch.

inserts.description: Audio-carrying callbacks from an earlier take. The spine is split at after_word_end; the insert plays between the parts with its own audio and an optional super.

after_word_end.description: Source time (on source.video) of the end of the word the insert follows.

denoise.description: light = afftdn with a conservative noise floor; only for phone or distant mics.

mode.description: proxy = 540x960, hardware encoder if available, fast preset, for iteration; final = 1080x1920 libx264.

threads.description: 0 = ffmpeg default. The render lock already serializes encodes.

max_frame_px.description: Longest side of any QA frame written for a model to read.

banned_words_file.description: One term per line (client surnames, street names). Checked against every on-screen text field and the transcript words inside kept ranges.

still_on_noun_s.description: Override of platform-specs broll.still_on_noun_s. A still punch start must fall within this many seconds of a spoken line word.

notes.description: Free text copied into RUNNOTES: why this version exists, what changed.
